flow: retrieve evidence before building new proof
regenerate all outward career surfaces from retained truth

separation_of_concerns.mega-skills: career control-plane logic, evidence weighting, mission continuity, and projection contracts
separation_of_concerns.job-application: public hiring presentation and delivery surface
separation_of_concerns.linkedin: external recruiter/social projection, never source authority

hard_rules: Private evidence cannot leak into public projections unless a separately reviewed public-safe derivative exists.
Candidate narrative never satisfies a hard gate by itself.
Generic engineering evidence cannot satisfy customer-facing or production-LLM requirements unless the evidence explicitly demonstrates that behavior.
Target requirements expire and must be refreshed from current role sources.
A score is evidence coverage only; never label it hiring probability or employer fit.
